book.name: 2 TIMOTE
book.title: Mukaana wu a myele kundaa Timote

content: Tsala nsia a Ndagha a Nzaami
Ŋa nkulu a Nzaami ya ŋa nkulu a Yiisu-Kriste wu akala aalamana baba mweẽ ya ba bákpi, ya mu nkwumu a Kriste wu akala aamoŋono kunsa a empu e nde, me ngwi we litumu li:

Aakatsala nsia a Ndagha a Nzaami, aakasa epini mu okaluo yo matala mwohono, ngu okala mu matala ma mabwe bwunu we ma mabi, aakabihi maluo ma mabi, aakasyeme, ŋa aakaluo aakagwa mpama kunsa okuru mukolo mu okebe .

Mu kuulu, matala sa magya maala baara ka bafiridzyi ogyughu maluo mama nsumu o. Lo bwunu a bu badzyi bo, bo sa basagha okala a baluo balagha ba akala baakabululyele bo mandagha ma badzyi bo okagyughu.
Bo sa babihi okagyughu maluo mama engaŋma, sa bagwuŋumu mu okabulugyughu masaba.
Lo we, aakakala a nzya-nzyara yi faana ya yi budziri mu mandagha mwohono, aakakuru mukolo ŋa nkulu a mpara, aakatsala nsia a Nsia yi Mbwe, aakasala esala e we kii muluo kuu mukughu.
Omana obara ntyini ya okebe kana
Mu kuulu, mu mi mitala me, matala ma aangye me maato, mu kuulu batsala makili ma me ti anga mukaba.
Me aandzwana mvulu yi mbwe, me aamana obara ntyini, me aankebe kana.

Obaana matala ma, Nzaami aalwunu me muburu wu a bunsumu. Mu etsughu ekye, Mfumu, nsughu a lamana wu a nsumu, sa agwa me nde, ya ka yini a kundaa me aagwa nde o, lo si kundaa baara bwohono ba bali mu okakebe ya dzyi omoŋono o nde.
Mansia mama masini
Sa mpini mu obaayamono me.

Mu kuulu, mu nkooro a dzyi li bilogho bi nsie yi, Demase aabulunyaghala me ya aagyene ku bvulu lili Tesalonike. Lo Keresense aagyene ku etsulu e nsie kii Ngalati, ya Tite ku etsulu e nsie kii Dalamati.
Yini a Luk li ya me. Gwolo Mareke ya ligya ya nde, nde li mupfunu mu esala e me.
Me aangweghe Tisyike ku bvulu lili Efedze.
Ŋa akala aagya we, gya a me enkuru e me ki ela kii kobo ki áli ansihi me kundaa Karapose ku bvulu lili Torowase. Yabiri si mikaana, emvulu-ngughu mikaana mi básono mu bibaana bi banyama.
Alesandere muntsulu bisyeẽ aamwehẽ me mpara yi alagha. Mfumu sa abvurulu nde bwunu a bu oli bigyighili bi nde.
Wehe si, sa mayele mu nde, mu kuulu nde aatemene maluo ma bihi ngangala mu ebaghala.
Mu matala ma aakankala me nyuru a me ŋa nkulu a bansughu-a-lamana mu sa lili nsomo, me aandi ngasighi. Baara bwohono baanyaghala me. Nzaami anyaã osyeme bo mu ndagha oyo!
Mfumu ndeme aabaha me ya aagwi me mpini mpaala mu me Nsia yitsaŋama mu eteese kii mukughu, ya mpaala ba baala ka bali ba-Dzwife o bagyughu yo. Ya nde aakwulu me ŋa muŋma a nkoho!
Mfumu sa akwulu me mu mandagha mwohono ma mabi ya nde sa abvwuhu me mu nkooro a Emfumu e nde kii mayulu. Nyaã nsia yikala kundaa nde mu mibvu ya mibvu! Aamene!
Mamboro mama masini
Gwa Pirisika ya Akila mamboro, gwa nzo a Onesifore mboro.
Erasete aabulusyili ku bvulu lili Korente ya me aabulunsihi Torofime mubyele ku bvulu lili Mile.
Sa mpini mu ogya nsomo lito mu ndo yi a mpie yi alagha. Ebulose, Pudense, Linuse, Kolodya, ya bandughu mu kana bwohono bagwi we mamboro.
Nyaã Mfumu akala ya mufulu a we!

content.text: Nyaã bwehe bu Nzaami bukala ya be!
